name: Xperia Z Ultra

images.credit: Maurizio Pesce, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: Sony Xperia Z3 Tablet Compact (SGP412 Only), Sony Xperia XA Ultra (As a phablet)

Network.Technology: GSM/GPRS/EDGE 850/900/1800/1900, HSPA+ 850/900/1700/1900/2100, LTE 800/850/900/1800/2100/2600, (Network specifications varies across models)

Body.Other: Available in black, purple and white, IP55/IP58 (Dust protected, Water jet protected & Waterproof), 1seg (C6843 and SOL24 variants only), Osaifu-Keitai (SOL24 variant only), LISMO (SOL24 variant only), POBox Touch 6.2 (SGP412 and SOL24 variants only)

Platform.Operating system: Android Jelly Bean, Android 4.2.2 "Jelly Bean" (launch), Android 4.3 "Jelly Bean", Android KitKat, Android 4.4.2 "KitKat", Android Lollipop, Android 5.0 "Lollipop", Android 5.1.1 "Lollipop" (current)

Memory.Storage: 16 GB (32 GB for SGP412 and SOL24 variants)

Cameras.Rear camera: Sony 8.0 MP back-side illuminated sensor, 1080p video recording @ 30 frames/s 16x digital zoom

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi, Digital Living Network Alliance, DLNA, Miracast, GPS/GLONASS, Near Field Communication, NFC, Bluetooth Bluetooth v4.0, 4.0, Mobile High-Definition Link, MHL, High-Definition Multimedia Interface, HDMI (via MHL), micro USB 2.0 USB On-The-Go, OTG, FM radio
